coverage.theme: 主动攻击与主动访问后感染的通信角色
coverage.note: Endpoint count and SRC/DST direction are investigation entry points; role and infection require request, object, process and timing evidence.
Pure SYN scan has no HTTP User-Agent. Tool names are mutable candidate markers.

coverage.theme: TCP标志、三次握手与序列号
coverage.note: ACK validates acknowledgement number; PSH is not a payload predicate. Relative sequence zero is not the raw ISN. Data may accompany establishment.
FIN affects one direction; combined FIN/ACK, simultaneous close and reset prevent a rigid four-frame assumption.
Use responding server tcp.srcport for SYN/ACK service ports. Match streams and distinguish refusal, no observed response and completed application interaction.

coverage.theme: 批量认证、长度变化与成功会话
coverage.note: Frequency, five-second duration, POST and response length do not prove guessing or success. Ordinary SSH authentication is encrypted; use host logs.

coverage.theme: 哈希碰撞与会话令牌猜测
coverage.note: Collision, password guessing, token enumeration and preimage search are distinct. Decodable JWT does not prove accepted signature or session hijack.
NBNS is NetBIOS naming, not dynamic DNS. Correlate actual name, suffix, response and time without deriving missing screenshot values.
Use Request/ACK, transaction ID, client identifier and lease timeline. Hostname alone does not prove tablet identity; offer is not final assignment.
Preserves historical NT token examples as claims, warns of spoofing and UA reduction; NT 10.0 does not distinguish Windows 10/11.

Distinguishes client-TGS and client-service session keys, long-term keys and subkeys; encrypted timestamp is time rather than random nonce; tickets do not contain an encrypted password. Ticket issuance, service authentication and authorization are separate.

SMB is not printer proof; client dialect offer differs from selected response. NTLM challenge is 8 bytes; response is not NT hash. Final Session Setup status differs from interim continuation and other-command success.

coverage.theme: 一句话入口、动态执行与参数
coverage.note: Explains parameter/decode/execute/response locations without publishing a runnable shell or executing extracted text.
2011/2014/2016 details are image-only; no fabricated exact signatures. General code/Base64/parameter and static validation preserved.

Covers initialization, boundary markers, representation decoding and weak UA. Source CHR and CHR16 pasted sequences cannot prove distinction; require actual notation and allowlisted conversion, never eval.

coverage.theme: 冰蝎早期动态密钥与加密交互
coverage.note: GET/POST key exchange, Session/Cookie correlation and per-layer verification retained as some implementations; 16-byte response or fixed Accept cannot establish family.

coverage.theme: 冰蝎静态派生密钥与二进制封装
coverage.note: MD5 prefix as ASCII differs from raw digest bytes. octet-stream is generic binary MIME, not a one-file/one-parameter constraint; fixed 5720/5740 counts omitted as unverified.

coverage.theme: 冰蝎版本、临时端口与请求头
coverage.note: 49700-range source ports and increments do not establish version. Form MIME and mutable headers are candidates, not universal signatures.

coverage.theme: 哥斯拉功能与主机影响
coverage.note: Groups command, files, databases, archives, screenshot, credential access and memory modules as decoded operation candidates; does not execute plugin/tool functions or infer actual privilege impact.
Covers URL/Base64/XOR layering, key representation, index offset, response markers and Session; exactly three POSTs is not universal.
Separates repeated loader field and changing operation field; names and keys require actual server implementation; no real/default secret printed.
RAW differs from form/Base64 envelopes; preserve actual boundaries, key bytes and XOR offset.

coverage.theme: Shiro rememberMe、反序列化、执行和内存马
coverage.note: Historical affected condition verified. deleteMe is clearing logic, not conclusive framework/login/exploitation evidence. Cookie length, 200 and output symbols do not prove execution. Use config, logs, process and memory evidence; no gadget execution.
Retains transfer-to-process-to-privilege-change chain. Local CVE cannot be confirmed from traffic or scanner label; host audit and patched package state required. Exploit commands excluded.

coverage.theme: Dify数据库身份、上传key与文件读取
coverage.note: No version or usable screenshots supplied. Fixed credentials removed, roles split, storage key semantics contextualized, metadata/read path/response hash chain required; no database updates or request replay.
All table screenshots missing; practical filters rebuilt and documented by official field tables. No claim to reproduce missing image rows exactly.
No standalone TLS/RDP source section. Root task explicitly requested current protocol checks; content remains a decryption boundary within traffic workflow, not a new page.

image_audit.resolution_method: URL-decode every relative Markdown image target, resolve against D:/winoptimizeDir/Desktop, test exact local path existence.
image_audit.inference_policy: Only general concepts, official protocol semantics and explicitly constructed scenarios added. No screenshot-only frame numbers, addresses, bytes, keys, lengths or observed result fabricated.

NBNS/DHCP host names and device identification screenshots unavailable.
Kerberos encrypted fields/PAC contents and SMB negotiation/NTLM bytes unavailable.
Historical Caidao version signatures and AntSword encoded payload examples unavailable.
Behinder key exchange, version-specific headers/payload lengths and Godzilla request/response wrappers unavailable.
Shiro command output/memory-shell, PwnKit execution and Dify file-read screenshots unavailable.

commands.heading: ### 14.1 主机、会话与时间三种统计一起看
commands.command:
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng -q -z io,phs
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng -q -z endpoints,ip -z conv,tcp -z conv,udp
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng -q -z io,stat,1

commands.heading: ### 15.2 从初始 SYN 到可见端口状态
commands.command:
# 初始建连请求：列时间、双方端口与流号
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng \
  -Y 'ip.src == 192.0.2.10 && ip.dst == 192.0.2.20 && tcp.flags.syn == 1 && tcp.flags.ack == 0' \
  -T fields -E header=y -E separator=/t \
  -e frame.number -e frame.time_epoch -e ip.src -e tcp.srcport \
  -e ip.dst -e tcp.dstport -e tcp.stream -e tcp.seq_raw

# 服务端 SYN/ACK：开放候选应统计服务端源端口
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng \
  -Y 'ip.src == 192.0.2.20 && ip.dst == 192.0.2.10 && tcp.flags.syn == 1 && tcp.flags.ack == 1' \
  -T fields -e tcp.srcport | sort -n -u

# 服务端复位：回到同一流检查它响应的是哪个请求
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng \
  -Y 'ip.src == 192.0.2.20 && tcp.flags.reset == 1' \
  -T fields -e frame.number -e tcp.stream -e tcp.srcport -e tcp.dstport

commands.heading: ### 16.1 把频率、失败和成功分开证明
commands.command:
tshark -n -2 -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng -Y 'http.request || http.response' \
  -T fields -E header=y -E separator=/t \
  -e frame.number -e frame.time_epoch -e tcp.stream \
  -e http.request.method -e http.request.uri -e http.response.code \
  -e http.response_in -e http.request_in
rg -n 'Failed password|Invalid user|Accepted password|Accepted publickey' \
  ./evidence/logs/auth.log*

commands.heading: ### 17.1 名称、租约与客户端声明
commands.command:
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng -Y 'nbns' -V
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng -Y 'dhcp' \
  -T fields -E header=y -E separator=/t \
  -e frame.number -e frame.time_epoch -e dhcp.id -e dhcp.hw.mac_addr \
  -e dhcp.option.hostname -e dhcp.option.dhcp -e dhcp.ip.your \
  -e dhcp.option.dhcp_server_id
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng -Y 'http.request' \
  -T fields -e frame.number -e ip.src -e http.host -e http.user_agent

commands.heading: ### 18.2 读取报文与判断认证边界
commands.command:
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng -Y 'kerberos' \
  -T fields -E header=y -E separator=/t \
  -e frame.number -e frame.time_epoch -e ip.src -e ip.dst \
  -e kerberos.msg_type -e kerberos.CNameString -e kerberos.SNameString \
  -e kerberos.realm -e kerberos.etype -e kerberos.error_code

commands.heading: ### 19.2 状态必须绑定具体命令与响应
commands.command:
tshark -n -2 -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng -Y 'smb2 || ntlmssp' \
  -T fields -E header=y -E separator=/t \
  -e frame.number -e frame.time_epoch -e tcp.stream \
  -e smb2.cmd -e smb2.msg_id -e smb2.sesid -e smb2.tid \
  -e smb2.nt_status -e ntlmssp.auth.domain -e ntlmssp.auth.username

# Session Setup 的成功响应候选
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng \
  -Y 'smb2.cmd == 1 && smb2.flags.response == 1 && smb2.nt_status == 0' -V

commands.heading: ### 20.2 按传输层次逐层拆解
commands.command:
# URL/form 表示层：只处理已有字段，输出副本
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote_to_bytes
text = Path('./work/payload.txt').read_text(encoding='ascii').rstrip('\r\n')
Path('./work/payload-url.bin').write_bytes(unquote_to_bytes(text.replace('+', ' ')))
PY

# 对确认有一层 Base64 的字段做严格解码
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64
from pathlib import Path
data = Path('./work/payload-url.bin').read_bytes()
Path('./work/payload-decoded.bin').write_bytes(base64.b64decode(data, validate=True))
PY
sha256sum ./work/payload*.bin
file ./work/payload-decoded.bin
xxd -l 64 ./work/payload-decoded.bin

commands.heading: ### 21.1 Shiro rememberMe：框架线索、处理错误和成功行为
commands.command:
tshark -n -r ./evidence/capture.pcapng \
  -Y 'http.cookie contains "rememberMe" || http.set_cookie contains "rememberMe"' \
  -T fields -e frame.number -e tcp.stream -e http.request.uri -e http.response.code
rg -n 'rememberMe|CookieRememberMeManager|cipherKey' ./evidence/app-config
